🌟 Why Volunteer?

  • ✅ Gain meaningful experience in animal care and hostel management.
  • ✅ Build teamwork, communication, and organizational skills.
  • ✅ Receive a certificate of appreciation for CEP contributions.
  • ✅ Make a positive impact on pets and the local community.
  • ✅ Flexible scheduling that fits around your studies or work.

📋 Volunteer Guidelines

  • 🐾Arrive on time and check in with the volunteer coordinator.
  • 🐾Follow all safety and hygiene protocols when handling animals.
  • 🐾Do not share personal information of pet owners with others.
  • 🐾Report any concerns or incidents to the coordinator immediately.
  • 🐾Treat all animals with kindness, patience, and respect.
